name: Synapse
design_target: AI Agents, LLMs, and Ultra-Low-Resource Freestanding Execution

semantics.memory_model: Freestanding stack buffers with deterministic bounds (zero GC, zero runtime engine)
semantics.primary_target: Native C99 compiled via clang -O3 (<1.6MB RAM, 20x faster than interpreted languages)
semantics.secondary_target: Instant in-memory nano-interpreter for development and linting

forms.description: Sequential block evaluated in order, yielding the value of the final expression.
Deterministic branch without dangling else ambiguity.
While-loop construct executing body as long as condition evaluates to true.
Fixed integer range loop iterating from 0 to count - 1.

canonical_examples.name: fibonacci
canonical_examples.syn:
(fn fib ((n i32)) i32
  (if (<= n 1)
    (ret n)
    (ret (+ (call fib (- n 1))
            (call fib (- n 2))))))

(fn main () i32
  (let res i32 (call fib 20))
  (println "Result:" res)
  (ret 0))

canonical_examples.name: collatz
canonical_examples.syn:
(fn collatz_steps ((n i32)) i32
  (let steps i32 0)
  (loop (> n 1)
    (if (== (% n 2) 0)
      (do (set n (/ n 2)))
      (do (set n (+ (* 3 n) 1))))
    (set steps (+ steps 1)))
  (ret steps))

(fn main () i32
  (let s i32 (call collatz_steps 27))
  (println "Steps:" s)
  (ret 0))

agent_instructions: When asked to solve logic tasks in Synapse, emit only valid S-expressions adhering to the forms above. Avoid markdown formatting inside strings. Never invent undeclared syntax forms.
